models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.description: Anthropic's most capable widely released model; successor to Claude Fable 5 in the same tier at the same per-token price. Thinking always on (adaptive; effort low..max); forced tool_choice any/tool rejected; requires 30-day data retention. Cache reads at 0.025x input.

models.name: GPT-6 Astra
models.description: OpenAI's most capable model, built for the hardest end-to-end work. 1.05M context (922K max input), 128K max output, reasoning effort low/medium/high/xhigh/max; no temperature (reasoning model). Prompts over 272K input tokens are billed at the long_context variant.

variants.note: Prompts with more than 272K input tokens: 2x input and cache rates, 1.5x output.

models.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
models.description: Google's most intelligent Flash model, for long-horizon software engineering and agents (GA 2026-09-02). 1,048,576 input / 65,536 output tokens; thinking_level low/medium/high (minimal rejected); temperature/top_p/top_k deprecated since 2026-07-21, so do not send them. Introductory price through 2026-12-31, standard rate from 2027-01-01 in the variant.

variants.note: Standard pricing starting January 1, 2027 (introductory rate ends 2026-12-31).

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.description: Anthropic's recommended default for most workloads; successor to Claude Opus 5 at a lower price. 1M context, 128K max output. Thinking always on (adaptive; default effort medium); forced tool_choice any/tool rejected; computer_20251124 not accepted. Cache reads at 0.05x input.

models.name: GPT-6 Sol
models.description: GPT-6 mid tier for complex coding and agentic workflows; successor to GPT-5.6 Sol at half the price. 1.05M context, 128K max output, reasoning effort none/low/medium/high/xhigh/max; no temperature (reasoning model). Prompts over 272K input tokens are billed at the long_context variant.

variants.note: Prompts with more than 272K input tokens: 2x input and cache rates, 1.5x output.

models.name: GPT-6 Luna
models.description: GPT-6 small tier for focused, high-volume tasks; successor to GPT-5.6 Luna. 1.05M context (922K max input), 128K max output, reasoning effort none/low/medium/high/xhigh/max; no temperature (reasoning model). Prompts over 272K input tokens are billed at the long_context variant.

variants.note: Prompts with more than 272K input tokens: 2x input and cache rates, 1.5x output.
